purpose: Allow complete audited source pipelines to qualify while preserving explicit row-level DATA_INSUFFICIENT instead of failing the entire stage.
soft_data_insufficiency: Exact official filing bytes are available but target facts cannot be extracted without inference.
An exact official earnings-related document has no unambiguous frozen UP/DOWN token; no direction evidence is emitted.
A Fundamental State row lacks required current/prior comparable facts; the row remains DATA_INSUFFICIENT and emits no PASS/WATCH/FAIL state.
A valuation row lacks a PIT TTM-EPS denominator or usable 20-day valuation comparison; the row emits no valuation evidence.
stage_qualification_semantics: QUALIFIED_INPUT means the source/materialization pipeline is complete and audited; individual records remain governed by availability_state and may be DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
downstream_consumption_rule: Only HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTABLE evidence rows may be consumed as historical evidence; DATA_INSUFFICIENT rows must remain unavailable.
